heading: Application of excess-land provisions of reclamation laws to certain lands
lead: The excess-land provisions of the Federal reclamation laws shall not be applicable to lands which on June 16, 1938, had an irrigation water supply from sources other than a Federal reclamation project and which will receive a supplemental supply from the Colorado-Big Thompson project.

ancestors.heading: RECLAMATION AND IRRIGATION OF LANDS BY FEDERAL GOVERNMENT
